body:
WIP here.
The example will take advantage of the state/onStateChange/createURL api on IS.
That way users will have a generic example (even though based on react-router), if they don't want to use history. (also, react-router is now using the v3 of history and our current impl were not compatible anymore).

Based on that, I'll will also have a look at our current browser impl (createHistory in v2 leads to createBrowserHistory), and see if we can simplify a bit what we have.
